status: NRRD selected-slice and request-aware scientific window pixel buffers now obey managed budget; gzip volume no longer retained in full
problem: Previous NRRD inflated whole volume into unmanaged Vec and allocated output outside request budget; scientific window output also unmanaged

implementation.gzip: Scan/decompress entire single gzip member to validate count, CRC/trailer and no trailing data; retain only selected plane bytes; cancellation per64KiB read
implementation.buffers: Selected gzip slice and float RGBA output use MemoryBudget buffers; raw/ascii output managed; request-aware shared NRRD/MRC window output managed
implementation.unchanged: Native sample values, endian handling, selected image metadata, explicit nonfinite window refusal
implementation.scratch_limit: Bounded64KiB stack read buffer plus flate2 internal decoder state; those and header strings are not pixel-budget accounting, not total process RSS

regressions.exact_budget: For every manifest state: source bytes + selected raw scratch for gzip +240-byte output; output alone retained after decode; one-byte-short admission fails and releases all credit
regressions.window_budget: Source +240-byte raw output +240-byte window output exact peak; one-byte-short window failure releases all
regressions.volume: 128 slices,3x2 ushort pixels; full uncompressed1536bytes; selected scratch12bytes plus output96bytes fits108byte budget for slices0,63,127; damaged CRC after selection refused, final0

limitations: Not full NRRD qualification: detached files, higher dimensions/types/spatial interpretation remain pending
Sequential gzip scan still visits entire volume for a late slice; no random-access speedup claimed
No new Metal runtime verification in this change
Unbudgeted public windowed() convenience API has no request and remains unbudgeted; app decode_raster_with_window request path is budgeted
